title: A-label with bounded index
statement: For natural numbers $C,d$ and an index $i$, define an $A$-label indexed by $i$ when $i\le C+1$, and by $0$ otherwise; the label is drawn from the family whose $A$-indices range over $\text{Fin}(C+2)$.
